projects.name: Angular architecture study
projects.description: Study guides and TypeScript examples for Angular signals, HTTP interceptors, authentication flows and application architecture.
projects.limitations: Snippet collection, not a complete runnable application; missing referenced service implementations and automated tests. Framework version and security claims require independent verification.

projects.name: RxJS operator lab
projects.description: Angular demonstrations comparing switchMap, mergeMap, concatMap and exhaustMap, with a reactive search example.
projects.limitations: Simulated asynchronous requests, console-oriented demonstration and scaffold-level tests; subscription cleanup and deterministic operator tests need improvement. No production deployment verified.

projects.name: NgRx effects demo
projects.description: An Angular PokéAPI example connecting store actions, reducers and HTTP side effects to list and detail views.
projects.limitations: Angular 11 / NgRx 12 example with loose typing, no effect error handling and scaffold-level tests; should be described as a learning demo, not enterprise architecture.

projects.name: TypeScript type-system examples
projects.description: Focused examples of generics, unions, mapped types and utility types, alongside a type-system study reference.
projects.limitations: No automated test suite; the test script deliberately exits with an error. Lint and formatting commands reference packages absent from the manifest.
